description.value: Yogurie is a dessert cafe in Richmond's Buswell Street area, serving sweet treats late into the night. Its extended daily hours make it a notable stop for evening cyclists looking for a post-ride indulgence. The cafe is part of a strip mall unit in a residential-commercial neighbourhood of Richmond.
